title: Tech Note: Adding Data Tables in a Write Pro Document
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write Pro table support has matured substantially since v17R6 — later versions added the ability to insert/delete rows and columns natively and improved table formatting, so some of the 'not possible as of 17R6' limitations noted here (e.g. removing/adding columns) have since been addressed. The core object-range-based API (WP Insert Table, WP Table append row, WP SET ATTRIBUTES) is still the current approach.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro table manipulation commands were expanded in later 4D versions (row/column insert-delete became easier)
4D Write Pro remains the current, actively developed document/word-processing engine, having fully superseded the legacy 4D Write plugin
